orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Lok Pal Singh
orders.text:
CRLR No. 188 of 2019 
Hon’ble Lok Pal Singh, J.
 Ms. Anjali Noliyal, Advocate for the 
revisionist. 
 Mr. Sandeep Tandon, Dy. A.G. with Mr. 
Lalit Miglani, Brief Holder for the State. 
 Heard. 
On 27.05.2019 in the order sheet, Registry 
made following endorsement: “As per report of 
learned C.J.M, District Haridwar, the notice has 
bee service to notice”. 
 Despite service, there is no representation 
for respondent no.2. 
 In view of above, service upon respondent 
no. 2 is held sufficient. 
 In the interest of justice, list this matter on 
17.06.2019. 
(Lok Pal Singh, J.) 
 28.05.2019 Mamta

orders.text:
CRLR No. 188 of 2019 
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J. 
Mr. Avidit Noliyal, Advocate for the 
revisionist. 
Mr. P.S. Bohra, A.G.A. for the State of 
Uttarakhand. 
Mr. Niranjan Bhatt, Advocate holding 
brief of Mr. Abhishek Verma, Advocate for 
respondent no. 2. 
The respondent no. 2 has put in 
appearance through her counsel Mr. Abhishek 
Verma by filing a vakalatnama on 14.06.2019. 
Learned counsel for the respondent prays 
for and is granted two weeks’ time to file the 
objection to the delay condonation application 
filed by the revisionist. 
List this case immediately after two 
weeks. 
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.) 
 17.06.2019 
Pooja
